observations: Water is leaking from the P-trap assembly under the kitchen sink.
Multiple joints on the drainage pipe appear to be leaking.
title: Leaking P-trap under kitchen sink
explanation: The drainage pipe under your sink is leaking at the joints. The plumber will inspect the pipe assembly and likely replace the P-trap or tighten the connections to fix the leak. Please place a bucket under the leak to catch the water and avoid using the sink until the repair is complete.
